home.metaTitle: Kuulis · Motorbike rides, no commission per ride
home.metaDescription: Get a motorbike ride in minutes and pay the driver directly, however you agree. Drivers pay no commission per ride, just a small monthly fee in the months they work.
home.title: Your ride in minutes. No commission per ride.
home.lead: Request a motorbike near you, see the price before you go and pay the driver directly, however you agree.

price.title: Price before you go
price.body: The app prices the ride by distance and time. You see it before you request and it does not change on the way.

pay.title: Pay your way
pay.body: Cash in dollars or bolívares, pago móvil, Zelle or Binance: agree with the driver and pay them directly.

safe.title: Never alone
safe.body: You see the driver's name, photo, bike and plate, and you can share your ride with someone you trust.

drivers.title: What you earn is yours
drivers.body: Kuulis takes nothing from your rides. You only pay a small monthly fee based on what you earned, and only in the months you work. The first {months} months are free.
drivers.tableNote: No rides in a month, nothing to pay. The first {months} months are free.

how.title: Three steps and you are on your way

step1.title: Request a ride
step1.body: Choose where you are going and see the price.

step2.title: A driver accepts
step2.body: We show you who they are, their bike and how long until they arrive.

step3.title: Arrive and pay
step3.body: Pay the driver directly, with the method you agreed.

items.q: Does Kuulis take a commission on each ride?
items.a: No. The rider pays the full ride to the driver. The driver pays a monthly fee based on what they earned, and nothing in months they did not work.

items.q: How do I pay for the ride?
items.a: Directly to the driver: cash, pago móvil, Zelle or Binance, however you agree. The app sets the price and it is the same for both of you.

items.q: Why is it not on the Play Store?
items.a: For now the app is installed from this website. The Download page explains how to do it safely.

items.q: I have an iPhone, can I use Kuulis?
items.a: We are working on the iPhone version. Until then, the Android app is the only one available.

items.q: What do I need to drive?
items.a: Be of age, have your bike with its papers and upload your documents in the app. We review your application and let you know.

final.title: Start moving with Kuulis
final.body: Download the app, create your account and request your first ride.

drivers.metaTitle: Drive with Kuulis · No commission per ride
drivers.metaDescription: Earn with your motorbike without giving a commission on each ride. Requirements, monthly fee and how to sign up.
drivers.title: Earn with your bike, no commission per ride
drivers.lead: You bring the time and the bike; Kuulis brings the rides. What riders pay you is yours. The first {months} months are free.

commission.title: Zero commission
commission.body: We take nothing from your rides. The rider pays you directly, however you agree.

free.title: {months} months free
free.body: Start without paying anything. Then a small fee only in the months you work.

direct.title: You decide when
direct.body: Go online whenever you want and get rides near you.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.phone: An Android phone with data and GPS

fees.title: Monthly fee
fees.body: Based on what you earned in the month and paid from your Kuulis wallet. The first {months} months are free.

steps.title: How to sign up
steps.step1: Download the app and create your account.
steps.step2: In Profile, switch to driver mode and fill in your application.
steps.step3: Upload your documents and the photos of your bike.
steps.step4: We review your application and let you know when you can go online.

download.metaDescription: Install the Kuulis app on your Android phone.
download.title: Kuulis for Android
download.lead: The app is installed from this page, without going through the store.
download.fingerprintHelp: To check that the file is ours, its SHA-256 fingerprint must be exactly this one.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: We are finishing the first public version. When it is ready, you will find the file to install it here, with its version and its security fingerprint.

iphone.title: Have an iPhone?
iphone.body: The iPhone version comes later. We will announce it here when it is available.

android.title: How to install it
android.step1: Tap the download button and open the file when it finishes.
android.step2: If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser.
android.step3: Tap Install and wait a few seconds.
android.step4: Open Kuulis and create your account.
android.safety: Download Kuulis only from this page. We will never ask for your password over WhatsApp or the phone.

legal.metaDescription: Kuulis terms and conditions, privacy policy and community guidelines.
legal.title: Legal
legal.lead: The texts you accept when you use Kuulis. When they change, we tell you in the app.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: Tap the button to confirm this email is yours.
verify.doneBody: All set. You can go back to the Kuulis app.
verify.invalidBody: You may have used it already or it expired. Ask for a new one in the app, in Profile.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.body: Type the password you will use to sign in to Kuulis.
reset.tooShort: It must have at least 8 characters.
reset.doneBody: You can sign in to the app with your new password. For safety, we signed out your other sessions.
reset.invalidBody: You may have used it already or it expired. In the app, tap “Forgot password” to get a new one.
